messages:
tess: Heads-up — PR #7901 is ready for review but blocked on architecture sign-off. Changes: routing policy for fallback variants, KV cache config tweak, batching heuristic change. RFC: https://rfd.internal.redwood/rfcs/2026-model-routing-fallbacks (summary in PR). Please review SLO impact and canary plan.

mike: Can you summarise SLO/latency impact in one line? :eyes:

tess: TL;DR: p95 + ~8ms on long-seq (>=512) synthetic; avg token cost ~-4% due to improved cache hits; no schema change; added fallback priority to prevent cascades.

arjun: Need canary plan + smoke-test commands for infra. Who owns rollout?

tess: Suggested reviewers @lee (runtime), @sam (platform), @jordan (sre). Canary plan: 1) canary 5% 30m monitor p95/p99, error rate, cache_hit; 2) if ok 20% 2h; 3) full rollout. Smoke test (run against canary):

```
# long sequence canary test
curl -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"long sequence test","max_tokens":512}'
```

lee: I'll review tomorrow morning. Attach RFC diff and link section in PR; add canary steps. Confirm persisted cache migration?

tess: RFC diff linked; section 3.2 covers fallback ordering. No migration — cache key format stable; we add prefixing for checks.

sam: Does batching tweak change per-batch max? Need to check GPU mem on Dedicated.

tess: per-batch max reduced 128->112 for long seqs; dynamic heuristic allows bursts. Adding ops note for Dedicated.

jordan: From SRE ok. Add automatic rollback: if error_rate > 0.5% for 5m fallback to previous routing variant. Add to PR as policy?

tess: Added rollback policy YAML to PR.

deploy-bot: PR #7901 — CI passed, integration tests passed, lint passed.

lee: Will leave comments. If no major issues, can ack by noon PST.

tess: Holding merge until @lee signs off on arch section of RFC and @sam confirms Dedicated memory check. Will ping on updates. :pray:
